The '''oowor''' was a ranged [[Stun/Legends|stun]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] utilized by [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]]<ref name="GCG" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].<ref name="CSWE Ithor">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the weapon was archaic, "Oowor" was a given name for some Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|males]].<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The oowor was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
